mood: Trustworthy, Warm, Empathetic, Urgent but Clear

headings.usage: Use font-light for elegance or font-black for impact. Never default to standard bold.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs. Use p-8, p-12, p-16.
spacing_and_layout.marketing_pages: Bento 'Tetris' Grid. Asymmetrical layouts. Never fill 100% of the grid perfectly.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_pages: Control Room Grid. Map should take 60-70% of viewport width. Left sidebar for filters. Right for list/details.
spacing_and_layout.cards: Solid background, 1px subtle border (border-stone-200). Avoid heavy drop shadows, use crisp 1px borders and slight hover lifts (-translate-y-1).
spacing_and_layout.modals: Crystal Glassmorphism. backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 with a 1px solid white/40 border.

components.buttons: Flat, sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Text must contrast highly with background. On hover, use a lighter hue of the active color.
components.inputs: Use Shadcn components but heavily customized. Warm borders, no default blue focus rings. Use focus:ring-brand-primary or focus:ring-brand-secondary.
components.map: Leaflet. Hide default cluttered map UI if possible. Use custom colored markers (Terracotta for Lost, Moss for Found).
components.navigation: Header must have solid or glass background (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDFBF7]/80). Navigation links visible on desktop.
components.cards_report: Image gallery on top, details below. Use badges for 'Lost' / 'Found'. Provide clear contact/action buttons.

hero_banner.description: Warm sunrise over suburban neighborhood, feeling of hope.

app_texture_bg.description: Abstract soft textured background in pale terracotta and warm sand.

pet_reunited_1.description: Woman hugging a dog, feeling of reunion and relief.

pet_reunited_2.description: Black and white portrait of a woman hugging a dog.

interactions.hover: All interactive elements must have hover states. Do not rely on inheritance. Use specific colors (e.g., hover:bg-[#C95B42] hover:text-white).
interactions.transitions: Use specific properties (transition-transform, transition-colors duration-200 ease-out). Never transition-all.
interactions.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for creative landing page sections, but Shadcn components for complex interactions (forms, dialogs).
Never center-align large blocks of text. Left align paragraphs and dense content.
Avoid generic blue tones. Stick to the earthy palette provided.
When displaying maps, make them the hero of the dashboard view, surrounded by modular floating widgets or clean sidebars.
Implement 'Outfit' for headers and 'Manrope' for body text via Google Fonts in index.html.
Use the provided image URLs strictly. Never use placeholder services.
